Windows 时区 %q 没有 CLDR 对照: Windows time zone %q has no CLDR mapping
宿主时区设置只支持 Windows: Host time zone settings are only supported on Windows
宿主语言设置只支持 Windows: Host language settings are only supported on Windows
时区要填 host、preserve 或 IANA 时区，例如 Asia/Sha: The time zone must be host, preserve or an IANA time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai or Etc/UTC
语言标识无效，例如 zh-CN、en-US: Invalid language tag, for example zh-CN or en-US
语言要填 host、preserve 或语言标识，例如 zh-CN、en-US: The language must be host, preserve or a language tag, for example zh-CN or en-US
